name: AOL Platform Reuse Scoring
description: Scoring criteria for evaluating offshore platforms for reuse potential. Scores sum to 100 points. Higher score = stronger reuse candidate.

criteria.label: Pending Removal
criteria.description: Whether removal is still pending (not yet completed). Unremoved structures retain reuse opportunity.
criteria._note: removal_completed=false means still pending => full 40 pts

criteria.label: Water Depth
criteria.description: Shallower water = lower cost, easier access, wider reuse market. Scored in tiers by feet.
criteria._note: Evaluated top-down; first matching threshold wins

criteria.label: Modification Applications
criteria.description: Count of MODIFICATION applications (not initial). More modifications = active operational interest and higher reuse likelihood.
criteria._note: Evaluated highest-to-lowest minCount; first matching threshold wins

criteria.label: Recent Activity
criteria.description: How recent the latest removal application is. Recent activity signals ongoing regulatory engagement and reuse relevance.

criteria.label: Approval Record
criteria.description: Has a formal approval on record (approved: true). Indicates positive regulatory standing.

fieldMapping.water_depth_ft: Water depth at platform location in feet
fieldMapping.removal_completed: Boolean — true if removal has been completed
fieldMapping.modification_app_count: Integer — number of MODIFICATION-type applications filed
fieldMapping.latest_app_year: Integer year of the most recent removal application
fieldMapping.has_approval: Boolean — true if a formal approval is on record
